query:
UPDATE users
        SET 
            username = $1,
            password = $2,
            otp_verified = $3,
            otp_base32 = $4,
            otp_auth_url = $5,
            created_at = $6,
            updated_at = $7,
            recovery_codes = $8,
            password_is_expired = $9,
            is_admin = $10
        WHERE id = $11
